plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Business Information Professional I Certificate' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 27, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7990/PublishedPdf). This is a collaborative certificate between ARC, CRC, and FLC; certificate candidates must meet with counseling to ensure local unit requirements are met; can be completed 100% online. Map states Total Units 21.5-25; lower bound 21.5 encoded = 13 + 8.5 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 3+3+2+2+3 = 13; Sem 2 2+2+1+0.5+3 = 8.5). Semester 1 composition choice: ENGL C1000 College Composition OR BUS 100 English for the Professional (the map's 'or' after 'College Composition' pairs with the BUS 100 row on the following page; the placement prerequisites confirm this is the composition/ESL-pathway alternative). ENGL C1000 requires eligibility to enroll via CRC's placement process (or ESL 130 completion for ESL-sequence students); BUS 100 requires ESLR 320 and ESLW 320 (advisory: BUSTEC 302 and 303) — these ESL courses are not sequenced in the map and are documented here, not encoded as plan prereqs, since they apply to only one choice option. Work Experience choice (BUS 498 or CISC 498): 0.5-4 units, lower bound 0.5 encoded. Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): BUSTEC 307 advisory CISC 302; CISC 302 advisory BUSTEC 302; CISA 340 advisory CISC 302 or 310; CISA 305 advisory CISC 302 or 310; CISA 315 advisory CISC 302 or 310; CISA 126 advisory BUSTEC 302 with a grade of C or better. MATH 300 prerequisite per map: Intermediate Algebra or the equivalent (documented here; not a course code). Cross-college substitutes per map footnotes: CISC 300 (ARC/SCC) or BUSTEC 309 (FLC) for CISC 302; BUSTEC 366 (FLC) for CISA 340; BUSTEC 360 (FLC) for CISA 305; BUSTEC 362 (FLC) for CISA 315; BUSTEC 126 (FLC) for CISA 126.
